scope: current rankings scoped to the active world; category standings are captured at seasonal close
overall: unchanged FUR-2 score: 10 per building level, 20 per technology level, 100 per captured neutral outpost
economy: 10 points per building level, summed over the account colonies in that world
research: 20 points per technology level, summed over the account colonies in that world
pve: 100 points per currently captured neutral outpost, summed over account colonies
war: sum of immutable FUR-3 war score events; seasonal rows include events in the inclusive season window
regions: 2 points per region currently controlled by an account; season snapshot uses control at close
alliance: sum member FUR-3 military events in active world; live ranking uses current members, season archive uses event-time alliance attribution
tie_break: score descending then stable account/alliance ID ascending
season_snapshot: At close, freeze current overall/economy/research/pve/region state and in-window war events; do not backfill category standings for seasons archived before this version
